risks.risk: Drum capacity/volume unknown (drums of this style range widely, e.g. 60L-220L, with very different prices).
risks.proof: A close-up photo showing an embossed liter marking, or a tape measure against the drum height/diameter.
risks.if_unproven: cannot be priced at all without this; capacity drives the entire price range for this item type

risks.risk: Photo may be a generic stock/catalog image (watermark 'SUNNY EMEKA GENUINE') rather than the actual drum(s) in the seller's current possession.
risks.proof: A fresh, unwatermarked photo of the actual drum(s) for sale, ideally with today's date or a handwritten note visible.
risks.if_unproven: priced as used/uncertain stock, not guaranteed fresh inventory

risks.risk: Condition (new vs used/reconditioned) not verifiable; reused chemical drums are common and sell far lower than new food-grade drums.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the drum interior and any manufacturer/food-grade markings.
risks.if_unproven: priced as used/unknown-grade, not new food-grade

risks.risk: Unclear whether listing is for one drum or the whole batch shown (pricing unit ambiguity).
risks.proof: Seller confirmation in writing of unit being sold (one drum vs full lot) matched with a count in a photo.
risks.if_unproven: priced per single unit, lowest plausible count

risks.risk: Lid seal/ring condition (tight seal affects usability for liquid storage) not visible in detail.
risks.proof: Close-up of the lid ring and clasp mechanism.

proof_requests: Close-up photo of one drum showing embossed liter capacity and any brand/food-grade marking.
A fresh, non-watermarked photo of the actual drums currently available, with a measuring tape or common object for scale.
Confirmation of how many drums are included in this listing's price.
Close-up of the lid and locking ring mechanism.
Photo of drum interior to assess cleanliness/prior contents.
response.reason: The drums' capacity, which is the primary price driver for this item type, cannot be read from the photo, and the image appears to be a possibly generic/watermarked stock photo rather than confirmed current stock, so even a worst-case price cannot be anchored without a size reference and a confirmed photo of the actual item.
